command:
set -euo pipefail
set -a
. $HOME/.config/frankenstein/chatgpt-client.env
set +a
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, time, urllib.request
token=os.environ['FRANK_VOICE_BROKER_TOKEN']; base='http://127.0.0.1:'+os.environ.get('FRANK_VOICE_BROKER_PORT','8765')
headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+token,'Content-Type':'application/json'}
def call(method,path,payload=None):
 data=None if payload is None else json.dumps(payload).encode(); req=urllib.request.Request(base+path,data=data,headers=headers,method=method)
 with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=30) as r: return json.loads(r.read().decode())
h=call('GET','/health'); assert h['ok'] and h['machine_id']=='ai-core-node' and h['owner']=='gabriel' and h['person']=='gabriel'; print('HEALTH_OK active_sessions='+str(h['active_sessions']))
sid='live-smoke-v2-'+str(int(time.time()))
o=call('POST','/v1/session/open',{'session_id':sid}); a=o.get('identity_active_assembly',''); assert o['session']['identity_state']=='IDENTITY_REQUIRED' and o['session']['selected_person'] is None; assert 'CURRENT_HUMAN=UNKNOWN' in a and 'PERSON_SCOPE=LOCKED' in a; assert '<titan-person-memory>' not in a and '<emergent-retrieval>' not in a and '<inner-state>' not in a; print('OPEN_OK prebind_person_state_leak=NONE')
s=call('POST','/v1/session/select',{'session_id':sid,'person':'gabriel'}); assert s['session']['identity_state']=='BOUND'; epoch=s['session'].get('runtime_epoch_id'); assert epoch; print('SELECT_OK runtime_epoch='+str(epoch))
t=call('POST','/v1/session/turn-context',{'session_id':sid,'query':'Wer bist du und mit wem sprichst du gerade?','char_budget':1800}); assert t['ok'] and t['person']=='gabriel'; assembly=t['identity_active_assembly']; assert 'SELF=FranKenstein' in assembly and 'CURRENT_HUMAN=gabriel' in assembly and 'HOST_VERIFIED=true' in assembly; assert 'titan_context' in t and 'state' in t; print('TURN_OK identity_bytes=%d titan_bytes=%d emergent_bytes=%d canonical_turn_result=%s' % (len(assembly),len(t.get('titan_context','')),len(t.get('emergent_context','')),bool(t.get('state',{}).get('canonical_turn_result'))))
c=call('POST','/v1/session/close',{'session_id':sid,'reason':'live_smoke_v2_complete'}); assert c['ok'] and c['closed']; print('CLOSE_OK')
print('HEALTH_AFTER active_sessions='+str(call('GET','/health')['active_sessions']))
PY
echo CONVERSATION_PID=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p MainPID --value)
echo CLIENT_PID=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service -p MainPID --value)
